fair_value.method: Blend of forward P/E (60%) and FCF yield (40%) on Sep-2027 NTM (~FY28) figures: FY26 EPS ~$8.86 (9M $6.88 + ~$1.98 FQ4, incl. ~$0.1-0.2 one-off tariff refunds), FY27E ~$9.6 (+8%, consensus), FY28E ~$10.4 (+8%); $10.4 x 30x = $312 and FY28 FCF/share ~$9.6 capitalized at a 3.0% yield = $320; blended ~$315, below spot because a 35x multiple faces a 5.2% 10-year yield and a hiking Fed while memory costs rise another ~33% in 2027.

methods.name: Forward P/E on NTM EPS
methods.assumptions: NTM EPS at Sep 2027 = FY28E ~$10.4 (FY26 $8.86 -> FY27 $9.6 -> FY28 $10.4, ~8%/yr: price increases offset but do not reverse memory costs; buybacks ~2.5%/yr). Multiple 30x (was 30.5x): premium to Apple's 25-30x decade band for Services mix, but de-rated from ~35.6x because the 10-year is ~5.2% (earnings yield ~2.8% is well below the risk-free rate) and the FOMC started hiking on 2026-09-16.

methods.name: FCF yield
methods.assumptions: FY28 FCF ~$135B on ~14.0B diluted shares = ~$9.6/share; capitalized at a 3.0% FCF yield (~33x FCF, vs ~2.6-2.8% implied today), with the higher yield reflecting 5%+ Treasuries.

methods.name: Cross-check: Street consensus target
methods.assumptions: Mean analyst 12-month target ~$328 (range ~$215-400), used as evidence only, not blended.

bear.story: Memory at ~$2.00/Gb DRAM (+33%) for 2027 with no relief until 2028 outruns price increases: gross margin moves toward 45-46% and FY27 EPS stalls near $9.2-9.4; iPhone 18/Duo units fall after price hikes against the +22% iPhone comp; with a hiking Fed and 5%+ yields the multiple reverts to ~25x on ~$9.8 NTM EPS. Tail add-ons: a punitive China chip-tariff rate on 2027-06-23, or an adverse Google-payments appeal ruling.

base.story: iPhone 18 Pro and Duo demand holds, Services grows ~11-12% (FQ4 slowdown mostly FX), repeated price increases keep gross margin ~47% despite 2027 memory costs; EPS grows ~8%/yr to ~$10.4 NTM; multiple de-rates from ~35.6x to ~32x under higher rates, leaving price roughly flat.

bull.story: Gemini-based Siri and the foldable drive an upgrade supercycle; Apple's pricing power (not memory relief, which is not expected before 2028) pushes gross margin back to ~48%; FY28 EPS ~$11.6 and the multiple holds ~36x if rates stabilize or fall back.

thesis_break_reason: About -26% from $341, just above the 52-week low of $243 and ~26x FY27E EPS of $9.6. Rate-driven de-rating alone (35x to ~28-29x on intact ~$10 NTM EPS) takes the stock to ~$280-290 without a broken thesis, so I lowered the break from $260. A close below ~$252 would most likely mean earnings estimates are being cut: gross margin guided well below 46% as 2027 memory contracts outrun price increases, iPhone 18/Duo unit declines after the hikes, loss of the Google default-search payment, or a punitive China semiconductor tariff rate in June 2027.

Memory: 2027 DRAM ~+33% and NAND similar, with no relief until 2028; how much Apple can pass through in price without losing units
Whether iPhone 18 Pro + Duo sustain growth against the +22% iPhone comp and supply limits
Services growth: FX-driven slowdown versus the start of a structural App Store deceleration

Leadership transition to John Ternus and AI execution after the Gemini-based Siri launch
reasoning: Round 2 update. The supervisor's fact checks, which I verified, move me modestly lower. (1) Rates: the FOMC hiked 25bp to 3.75-4.00% on 2026-09-16 (12-0, first hike since 2023; 16 of 18 participants projected another hike) and the 10-year hit a 5.18% cycle high on Sep 24 (5.17% at the Sep 25 close). I ignored this in round 1. A ~2.8% earnings yield against 5.2% Treasuries makes de-rating risk asymmetric, so I cut the target multiple from 30.5x to 30x and raised the FCF yield to 3.0%. (2) Memory: DigiTimes/AppleInsider/MacRumors confirm Apple accepted ~$2.00/Gb DRAM (from ~$1.50) and higher NAND from Q1 2027, with shortages lasting into 2028. My round-1 bull case relied on memory prices rolling over in 2027, which is contradicted, so the bull case now depends on pricing power and its probability falls to 0.22 (price $420, from $435). (3) EPS: FY26 is ~$8.86 and FY27 consensus ~$9.6 (+8%), not my ~$9.9 (+11%). FY26 also includes one-off tariff refunds, so I cut FY27E to $9.6 and FY28E to $10.4. (4) Services slowdown is mostly FX (~5pt drag), so I trim only slightly to 11-12%. (5) The China chip tariff steps up on 2027-06-23 at a rate still to be announced, which I had only as a generic tariff risk. It adds mid-2027 left-tail weight. The Google payment is intact under current remedies, so it stays a tail risk. Result: fair value $315 (from $330): P/E $312 and FCF $320. The scenario mean is ~$331 (bear 245 @25%, base 335 @53%, bull 420 @22%). Scenario prices sit above fair value because product-cycle momentum (Duo, Siri, record highs) can keep the multiple elevated. Ladder: lognormal with median ~$334 (-2%) and sigma ~0.27 (up from 0.26 for the rate regime), with a slightly fattened left tail. P(>=341) = 0.475 (from 0.53), P(>=409) = 0.23, P(<239) = 0.12. I stay a little more constructive than a pure 30x-on-FY28 print because the rate shock is already in the $341 close and Apple has shown it can pass memory costs through (the 2026 hikes did not dent iPhone 18 Pro lead times). One caution: one Zacks FY27 figure ($8.46) is far below the ~$9.6 consensus. It looks stale or mis-dated, so I did not use it.
